newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil drilling highest since 1992 - Andersen.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil drilling highest since 1992 - Andersen.

text.p: Drilling for oil in northwest Europe has risen to its highest level in five years, a leading industry consultant said on Wednesday.

Exploration and appraisal drilling activity in the first half of the year was at its highest since 1992 and the results were "very encouraging", said Arthur Andersen's Petroleum Services Group in a report.

Arthur Andersen said Norwegian drilling during the first six months of 1997 was up by 142 percent over the first half of 1996. Britain maintained last year's level of activity, which itself was the best half year since 1996.
Exploration and appraisal activity in Denmark has doubled since 1996, according to the review.
Four new discoveries were made in British waters, in addition to four Norwegian discoveries, the consultants said.
Second quarter success rate in Norway was 36 percent and 22 percent in Britain although the latter figure could rise given 10 tight holes which could still be pronounced successful, they said.
